description.text: The Portuguese print of this alternate-art card came only in the Battle Arena Decks of Mega Charizard X and Mega Blastoise, which Brazil got as one box holding both decks, the Box Arena de Batalha Mega Charizard X VS. Mega Blastoise. One deck holds it as a plain card and the other as a Holofoil one.

tell.text: No foil anywhere on the card.
The picture shines; the rest of the card doesn't.
